author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: B.Sc. Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology is a 4-year undergraduate program. It gives students the appropriate training related to Anaesthesia and practical surgical procedures. In Bangalore, there are a total of 42 colleges that offer this course. Out of which 7 are government colleges and the other 35 are private institutions. Here, the BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology fees in Bangalore are also different depending on the college type. Most of the colleges are under Rajiv Gandhi University of Allied Health Sciences (RGUHS)

While private colleges provide this course with a fee structure, ranging from INR 70k to INR 2.5 lacs(yearly), the government colleges offer this program under INR 30k to 50k(yearly). In this article, we are going to cover BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology fees in Bangalore, its average fees, top colleges, government vs. private fees, and affordable options.
Looking for list of Bangalore colleges? Check “ BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Colleges in Bangalore 2025 ” to know all the colleges with placements and reviews.

sections.heading: Vydehi Institute of Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Center is in Whitefield, Bangalore, India. It offers the best BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology course in Bangalore. Here, students are given the scope of learning practical Anesthesia with surgical implementations. The fee structure here is divided into 3-time payment. In first year – Rs 3,50,000/-, and in 2nd & 3rd year – Rs. 1,75,000/-, totalling Rs 7,00,000/- in course fees .

sections.heading: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences is located in Chikkabanavara, Bangalore. It is affiliated with RGUHS and the Government of Karnataka. Here, the BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology course takes a total fee of Rs 6,50,000/- . The college takes Rs 2,50,000 in the first year and Rs 2,00,000/- in the second & third years.

This college offers the BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology course with a total fee of Rs 4,90,000/- . The total fee is divided into three instalments, in the first year – Rs. 1,60,000/-, in the 2nd year & 3rd year – Rs 1,65,000/-.

sections.heading: Manjushree Institute of Allied Health Sciences

The fee for BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology is 2.5 lakhs in the first year, 1.5 lakhs in the second year, and 1.5 lakhs in the third year, resulting in a total fee of 5.5 lakhs .
